mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, nickname, bio, campus, college, contact_info, avatar_url, interest_tags, skill_tags, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{bio}, #{campus}, #{college}, #{contactInfo}, #{avatarUrl}, #{interestTags}, #{skillTags}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profiles SET user_id = #{userId}, nickname = #{nickname}, bio = #{bio}, campus = #{campus}, college = #{college}, contact_info = #{contactInfo}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, interest_tags = #{interestTags}, skill_tags = #{skillTags}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
